method: Inspect the exact frozen authority context and all in-unit declarations without editing the authority.
Type-check every disputed measure, representative, norm, interval endpoint, normalization, monotonicity condition, and cross-reference against the same unit.
Require a complete independent source/target semantic replay before final admission.
Bind every mathematical and protected-reference change to an exact occurrence-scoped delta in the unit QA.
Reject stylistic or notation variation when the evidence does not prove a source error.

rejected_candidate.finding: Absolute-value bars are accepted notation for the Euclidean norm of a vector in this context. The later double-bar notation is a style variation, not proof of a type error.
